definitions: A small flap or strip of material attached to something for pulling, hanging, or identification.
A bill or account for goods or services, especially in a bar or restaurant.
A second or further page opened within a web browser window.
A key on a computer keyboard used to move the cursor to the next stop.
A small tablet, especially one containing an illicit drug.
examples: Put the drinks on my tab.
Switch to the next browser tab.
He took a tab of acid.
